Interface QueuedCommand

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientPayloadCommand, SystemCloseGameCommand, SystemDisconnectCommand, SystemJoinCommand, SystemSetupMatchCommand
public interface QueuedCommand
Base type for every element processed by a controller queue.

The server has one queue per controller level: pre-lobby, lobby, and game. Those queues do not contain only network messages. They contain all the work that a controller must process in order: client payloads routed by the network layer and internal server commands generated by lifecycle code or by another controller.

The common piece of information is the sessionId. It is the stable runtime identity used to ask ServerSessionRegistry for the current listener, nickname, lobby, or game. Commands should not duplicate those derived values.

  • Method Details

    • getSessionId

      String getSessionId()
      Retrieves the unique session identifier associated with this queued command.

      The session ID is used by controllers to resolve session-scoped resources (such as the player's nickname, network listener, or their corresponding player instance in a match) from the central registry.

      Returns:
      the unique session identifier, or null if the command is system-wide and not initiated by or bound to a specific client session
